summary: AI monitors, classifiers that flag dangerous behaviour by AI agents, are often evaluated against transcripts generated by attack policies acting as proxies for dangerous behaviour in deployment. summary: A sliding-window average is a simple estimator of the current state of a hidden regime-switching process, such as a hidden Markov model. title: The Look-Elsewhere Effect in Searches for New Physics: from Classical Methods to Machine Learning
summary: The look-elsewhere effect (LEE) arises when the location of an effect in parameter space is not specified in advance: scanning many locations inflates the significance of the largest excess, and the local $p$-value must be corrected into a global one.
